description: This Kotlin source file defines the CoilImagesPlugin class, a plugin for Markwon that integrates Coil image loading with custom authentication headers, specifically for loading images from sync providers like Nextcloud. It manages image request loading, cancellation, and drawable updates, and provides factory methods for creation with dependency injection.

classes.name: CoilImagesPlugin
classes.description: A Markwon plugin that loads images with Coil, adding support for authentication headers from Nextcloud configuration.

classes.name: CoilStore
classes.description: Interface for loading and canceling image requests.

classes.name: CoilAsyncDrawableLoader
classes.description: Handles asynchronous loading of images into AsyncDrawable objects, managing request lifecycle and caching.

classes.name: AsyncDrawableTarget
classes.description: Target implementation for handling success, start, and error callbacks during image loading.

methods.description: Factory method to create a CoilImagesPlugin with context and preferences, injecting dependencies.
